title: Liftability without spectrahedrality for a hyperbolicity cone
exact_target: Is there a real homogeneous hyperbolic polynomial whose closed cone has an exact finite semidefinite lift but is not itself the positive-semidefinite locus of any affine symmetric pencil in its original variables? Auxiliary variables are allowed for the lift but forbidden in the latter representation.
